Mumbai Landslide Death Toll Reaches Eight

A landslide in Mumbai's Ghatkopar area has resulted in eight fatalities. The rescue operations, which lasted for 32 hours, were called off after the body of a 28-year-old man was recovered. The incident occurred following heavy rainfall.
